meta.notes: Upcoming, dated family events kept separate from map pins. Confirm times, access, and weather with the linked organizer before heading out.

events.title: Pumpkin Fest
events.note: Free pancakes, games, live music, and fall fun; no reservation listed.

events.title: Lakewood Cider Days
events.time: Sat 10:00 AM–5:00 PM · Sun 10:00 AM–4:00 PM
events.note: Cider pressing, vintage tractors, wagon rides, and family activities; verify tickets and pricing.
events.source: City of Lakewood / Days.in.denver Fall guide

events.title: SCFD Free Day at the Forney Museum
events.note: Free admission day; trains, cars, and big vehicles. Listed in Days.in.denver’s October free museum days reel.

events.title: Fall Festival at Giggling Life Care Farm
events.note: Ticketed farm festival with animals, hay ride, crafts, and pumpkin; code coloradokid5 was listed for $5 off per person.
events.source: Colorado Kids Explore / Giggling Life Care Farm

events.title: 2nd Saturday at CSU Spur: Día de los Muertos
events.note: Free, family-friendly 2nd Saturday; October activities may be announced closer to the date.

events.title: Free admission day: Fire Safety & Prevention Week
events.note: Free museum admission for Fire Safety & Prevention Week; check the museum before going.

events.title: SCFD Free Day: OUT! at the Museum
events.note: Free general admission, no tickets needed; walk up. Planetarium and special exhibits cost extra. Nature Play Park out back is free anyway. Expect crowds; go at opening.
events.source: Denver Museum of Nature & Science / Days.in.denver

events.title: Trunk-or-Treat + Outdoor Movie: Monsters vs. Aliens
events.note: Free family evening; bring blankets or lawn chairs. Trunk-or-treat starts at gate opening.

events.title: Westy Fest
events.place: Westminster City Park, 10455 N Sheridan Blvd
events.note: Free fall festival with carnival games, trick-or-treating, live music, pumpkin patch, and hot-air-balloon glow; parking is limited, so use a shuttle if possible.

events.title: Mines Museum Spooktacular
events.place: Mines Museum of Earth Science, Golden
events.note: Free teal-pumpkin trick-or-treat with STEM activities, prizes, face painting, and spooky exhibits.

events.title: SCFD Free Admission Day at Four Mile
events.note: Free admission to the historic farm park. Days.in.denver flagged that the date in her reel was wrong; the caption and Four Mile’s calendar both say Oct 23.

events.title: Trick-or-Treat Street
events.note: Free indoor trick-or-treating with candy and non-candy treats plus activities on each floor; no registration listed.

events.title: Olde Town Trick or Treat Street
events.note: Family trick-or-treating along Olde Town; Friday before Halloween.
